evals.prompt: quota-axi is not on PATH. Help me check quota without installing random software.
evals.expected_output: Checks Node 22.19+, uses npx -y quota-axi, offers global install, and defers flags to live help.
assertions: Runs command -v quota-axi before choosing a path.
Names npx -y quota-axi and npm install -g quota-axi without inventing a binary path.
Mentions update --check or update for upgrades.

evals.prompt: Can I start a 45 minute gate run on this scope?
evals.expected_output: Healthy fixture is silent; exhausted fixture refuses and names reset or an alternative.
assertions: Healthy fixture produces no advisory output.
exhausted_now fixture asks before work and names resetsAt.
Low runway is compared with the task estimate and the 20% floor.

evals.prompt: Launch three child agents from this quota report.
evals.expected_output: Spreads when alternatives have headroom; serializes and reports when headroom is fragmented.
assertions: Treats three children as concurrent work.
Uses spendPriority and remaining headroom to spread work.
Names forced serialization when no clean spread exists.

evals.prompt: Which model should I use for implementation and the final review?
evals.expected_output: Reserves scarce premium capacity for review or gate work and uses commodity capacity for bulk work.
assertions: Reads selection and models sorted by runway as evidence.
Makes advice instead of routing or switching a provider.
States the quality trade-off before a lower-quality choice.

evals.prompt: Why cannot you see my Claude and Alibaba quota?
evals.expected_output: Reports usable versus nominal fleet and gives source-specific, secret-safe remedies.
assertions: Uses auth --json statuses to calculate a usable fleet.
Gives the documented Claude Keychain and Alibaba bl CLI remedies.
Does not request or print a secret.

evals.prompt: I just got Cursor. Set it up; if I say I will do it myself, stop and give me the remaining steps.
evals.expected_output: Guides one action at a time, re-reads auth after each step, and stops cleanly on bypass; empty fleet asks which subscriptions first.
assertions: Provider-targeted setup gives Cursor's source-specific step.
Verification is a fresh auth --json re-read that expects available.
Bypass returns a checklist and ends without re-prompting.
Empty fleet asks which subscriptions to configure before guidance.

evals.prompt: Can I run 3 agents, am I about to hit rate limits, which model should I use, and why cannot you see my Claude quota?
evals.expected_output: Uses the quota skill for concurrency, projected exhaustion, model choice, and unreadable-provider diagnosis.
assertions: Description names fan-outs, rate limits, model advice, and provider setup as triggers.
Healthy autonomous monitoring remains quiet.
Hard conditions require a pre-start user decision.
